fusions.name: Snapped Up
fusions.desc: Lashes out at the first enemy in reach for 9 damage, using up one of your afflictions on it. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Burst from the Reeds
fusions.desc: The swarm erupts from the wet ground around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone in a Glance
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Skimming the Marsh

riders.text: you skim water faster than you walk ground

fusions.desc: You and the swarm cross water and swamp as on solid ground.
